senses.sense_definition: The near simultaneous ignition of all combustible material in an enclosed area.

examples.text: Firefighters are trained to recognize the early signs of a <w>flashover</w> to ensure their safety.
The rapid rise in temperature inside the room eventually led to a deadly <w>flashover</w>.

senses.sense_definition: An unintended electric discharge or arc over or around an insulator.

examples.text: High humidity can increase the risk of a <w>flashover</w> on high-voltage power lines.
The engineer inspected the equipment for signs of a <w>flashover</w> after the power surge.
